An '''officer''' served aboard the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', and was reported to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] after dissenting to [[Vocis Kenit]]'s leadership of the frigate. The officer died mysteriously later.
